caption: The drawing depicts a single three-legged object resembling a wooden headrest, rendered in shades of brown with darker accents to indicate depth and contour. The headrest consists of a flat, elongated top section with two legs extending from either end and a third support in the middle, all of which curve gently downward. The object is placed on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or decorations. The background has a slightly textured appearance and shows some faint marks and soft tonal variations. There is a small label or inscription in fine text at the bottom right. The composition positions the headrest centrally, and the object’s orientation places its longer axis horizontally across the image.
title: Bootjack
